items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 52:1
items.html: Since the lower one is attached to the NHY of the upper one in a single wall, it follows that at the time when that first spirit finishes spreading into the lower one — that is, after it has received the whole discernment of its Mochin of Yenika [nursing] — in the secret of, ‘And the child grew and was weaned,’ the upper one no longer has anything to give it. Behold, the lack of the lower one’s bestowal is felt by the upper one as well, since they are attached to one another. And this arouses the upper one to rise as MAN to the one above it, in order to receive a new bestowal for the sake of the lower one. Therefore, this is considered as though the lower one raises its upper one as MAN to the one above it. (p. 892, Sub Header, ‘Behold’)
